name.en-US: The Eternal Happiness of the Saints

description.la: Quinque libri de aeterna sanctorum felicitate, ex nominibus quibus Scriptura eam designat (regnum, domus, civitas, hereditas, corona). 1616.
description.en-US: Five books on the eternal happiness of the saints, drawn from the names Scripture gives it: kingdom, house, city, inheritance, crown (1616). The Latin is the Vivès edition (1870-74) from an OCR scan; the English is John Dalton's translation (London: Richardson, mid-19th century).
description.pt-BR: Cinco livros sobre a felicidade eterna dos santos, a partir dos nomes que a Escritura lhe dá (1616).

sources.edition: Roberti Bellarmini Opera omnia, ed. Justin Fèvre, tom. 8 (Paris: Vivès, 1870-74).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.txt, Boston College copy) cleaned by script: running heads, page numbers and the reference-only footnote blocks removed, line-end hyphens joined, recognisable OCR slips corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bellarmine died in 1621; the Vivès edition of 1870-74 is public domain.

sources.edition: The Eternal Happiness of the Saints, trans. John Dalton (London: Richardson and Son, n.d. [18--]).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.txt): page heads removed, lines rejoined; a few chapter-opening letters lost to drop caps and some words split at line ends remain.
